description: Networks visible to the account — public, utility and private SDN networks — with their IP subnets, DHCP settings, routes, attached servers and peerings. Optionally only one zone. UpCloud: GET /1.3/network/.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

zone.description: Only networks in this zone, e.g. fi-hel1.

name: upcloud_list_networks
title: List networks
